hook: SCP-3688 is a dance. Perform its sequence correctly and you can't be hurt for as long as you keep going, and that is the whole anomaly. It's a short, light Thaumiel file, so go in expecting a joke told with a perfectly straight face rather than horror.
whyItMatters:
Thaumiel entries are the ones the Foundation puts to use, and this one shows the category at its most playful. The test logs are written in standard deadpan, with a baseball bat, chains and a car all failing against someone who is, in effect, just dancing.

The second half widens the gag into an institution. Three departments, including Kinetography, reverse-engineer the steps and staff a task force around them, which is a very Foundation response to discovering a magic dance.
thingsToNotice:
The comedy is in the escalation of the move list. A defensive field needs two dancers, a time-slowing set makes the performer appear to speed up, a sensory boost comes with a vocal part that hurts anyone it has already enhanced, and the duplicate set gets harder with every copy it summons because each copy has to join the routine.

The top of the table is PMK-05, five performers in perfect sync wiping out all solid matter in a pentagon about 20 m high, used only once outside testing in the "West Side Incident". The agents' nickname for the original sequence, the "Safety Dance", fits the same tone: none of this is treated as anything stranger than a training regimen.
